name: Spaceship 69c9912a on 4.8.8
description: A period-2 spaceship on the truncated square tiling 4.8.8 (touching neighbours), 5 cells, moving one lattice step every 2 generations (c/2). It runs the same way in the 512 rules from B2/S2 to B25678/S245678; the scene uses the rule it was found in. Found by JETCARP's soup search (seen 8,034 times). Flagged as most likely already known: small (5 cells), common (seen 8,034 times) and wide-range (512 rules) on an Archimedean tiling. We found no earlier report, but others may well have seen it, so it is not claimed.
